Home.title: Welcome
Home.heroTagline: Grown men doing things together, {associationName} does a great deal more than that!
Home.intro: Here you can create and browse upcoming events, pimp your profile, or take a look in our open archive where there is plenty to be found. Most of it sits behind a paywall, so make sure you sign in and request membership!
Home.upcomingEmpty: Nothing planned right now. Got an idea? Add a suggestion.
Home.visitorNote: You're seeing the public events. Members also see the association's own.

About.title: About us
About.motto: We have three guiding words here at Poligroup: joy, loyalty, heart. We live by them, always!
About.origin: Poli was informally founded in 2017 by Adam, Felix, Nils, John and Victor at Malmö University. The name Poli comes from PoliSoft, originally the name of a political satire project that went over so well that every project after it was named after Poli.
About.growth: With the help of our Head of Recruitment, Adam Inge Middlename Hermansson, the group has grown steadily ever since. Slowly at first, with one of the group's now most invaluable members, Petter "Pidde" Månsson, who went from being Adam's mysterious cabbage and broccoli roommate to an invaluable cornerstone.
About.arrivals: Not long after, a good bunch of lads, some former career criminals and assorted fuck boys made their entrance, such as Jacob "Faheem" Bergqvist and Jonathan (a dear child has too many names) Earnest. Close behind them came unforgettable characters like Richard the Lionheart Azar, Martin, and many, many more.
About.bond: What binds us together is our love for the computing machine in all its forms, shorts, games, music, art, and the making of all that through programming and the rest. But our journey has only just begun.
About.membershipBody: Sign in with Google and send a request. An admin lets you in, and only then do you see the association's own events, members and wishlists. Until then you see the same page a visitor does.

before.title: Before all this
before.body: A group who kept ending up in the same places. No association, no plans, just people who liked each other's company.

founding.title: It started properly
founding.body: The first time somebody said it out loud: we should do this more often. We have done it more often ever since.

firstTrip.title: The first trip
firstTrip.body: Proof the group could manage more than one evening at a time. We came home tired and booked the next one.

football.title: The football nights
football.body: What was meant to be one match became a tradition. The bar knows who we are now.

formalised.title: We became an association
formalised.body: Statutes, a board and a shared fund. Not for the bureaucracy, but so the things we share outlive us getting busy.

today.title: Today
today.body: Spread across several cities but sharing one calendar. That's why this site exists.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.controllerBody: {associationName} is the controller of the data on this site. If you have questions, get in touch with {contactName}.
dataItems: Name, email address and profile picture from your Google account when you sign in.
Nickname, title, fun title, bio and birthday — if you fill them in.
Which events you have signed up for and attended.
Privacy.dataNote: If you sign in with Google without being a member, we store nothing about you in our database.
Privacy.whyBody: To run the association: show who the members are, plan events and keep track of who is coming. The legal basis is the membership itself and the association's legitimate interest in organising its activities.
Privacy.whoBody: Only signed-in members. The information is not public, is not shared outside the association, is never sold, and is not used for marketing.
Privacy.whereBody: In a database hosted by Supabase on servers in Stockholm, within the EU. The site itself runs on Vercel.
Privacy.retentionBody: For as long as you are a member. If you leave, we may keep your name and event history as part of the association's record, but you can always ask for everything to be deleted.
rightsItems: Find out what information we hold about you.
Complain to the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (IMY) if you think we are getting it wrong.
Privacy.cookiesBody: We use a single necessary cookie, to keep you signed in. No analytics, no tracking, no ads. Pages with embedded content such as maps, Spotify and YouTube load it from those services, and their terms apply to that.
Privacy.contactBody: Write to {contactEmail} and we will help you.
